output.title: The Unglamorous Work
output.excerpt: Nobody is coming to fix the world. That is better news than it sounds. Somewhere in early adulthood, most people make a discovery that rearranges everything and that almost nobody says out loud: there are no adults in the room. summary: The Unglamorous Work is an essay of about 5,000 words arguing that the world's worst problems are no longer mainly a shortage of knowledge but a failure to act on what is already known. It breaks that gap into four points, where people fail to see the truth, trust one another, reach those nearby, and weigh the long term, and it offers a week of small, mostly unseen habits that repair each one.
